 Oral Judgment

1. This appeal is filed by the Insurance Company against the judgment and award dated 31.08.2019 passed by the II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bidar, sitting at Humnabad, [for short 'Tribunal'] in MVC No.260/2016 questioning the liability to pay the compensation.

entities.text: II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bidar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NC: 2025:KHC-K:7025 HC-KAR 2.
Brief facts of the case are that the injured claimant aged 54 years, met with an accident on 04.03.2016 and sustained grievous injuries.
He filed claim petition before the Tribunal seeking compensation of Rs.8,00,000/- from the respondents.
During pendency of the claim petition, he died, hence, his wife contested the matter.

The Tribunal after considering the entire evidence on record, awarded the compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- with interest at 9% per annum from the date of petition till realization and directed respondent No.2 - Insurance Company to pay the compensation.
Aggrieved by the said judgment, Insurance Company has preferred this appeal.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant/Insurance Company contended that deceased was proceeding as a pillion rider on motorcycle bearing registration No.KA- 39/H-4874 and it was ridden by one The Divisional Manager vs Shashikanth And Anr on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68177306/
2 Sharanabasappa in rash and negligent manner, as a result deceased fell down and sustained injuries.

entities.text: Divisional Manager vs Shashikanth And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He denied his liability on the ground that the policy produced at Ex.R1 is an Act Policy NC:
2025:KHC-K:7025 HC-KAR and risk of the pillion rider is not covered under the said policy.

In support of his contention, he relied on the decisions in the case of Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd., V/s.
Sudhakaran K.V. and others1 and also on Tilak Singh2 case.

entities.text:
Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd., V/s.
Sudhakaran K.V. and others1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He also contended that there is delay of 8 days in filing the complaint and thus submits that the Insurance Company is not liable to pay the compensation, therefore, he prays for setting aside the impugned judgment and award passed by the Tribunal.
4. Heard arguments of both the parties and perused the materials available on record.
Respondent No.2 / owner of the offending motorcycle though served, remained unrepresented.
5. Admittedly, it is an Act Policy and the deceased was travelling as a pillion rider.

Under Act Policy,
risk of the pillion rider is not covered.
No additional premium 2008 AIR SCW 4549 2006 4 SCC 404 NC: 2025:KHC-K:7025 HC-KAR was paid by respondent No.2.
Hence, appellant/Insurance Company is not liable to pay the compensation and they are exonerated from the liability.
The wife of claimant is at liberty to recover the compensation awarded by the Tribunal from the owner of the vehicle.

6. In the result, the following order is passed:
 (i) Appeal is allowed.
 (ii) The Insurance Company is exonerated from the liability to pay the compensation awarded by the Tribunal.

(iii) The respondent No.2 - owner of the offending motorcycle is directed to pay the compensation to the wife of the claimant with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization, within one month from the date of this judgment.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7025 HC-KAR (iv) Amount deposited by the Insurance Company is to be refunded to it.
